lines.text: They tell me to ask if I can inherit the earth,
to ask if I can name my own stars, even galaxies if I may.
The past too was waiting for me.
Coming of age in the shared rooms of human basements
as bedrooms, mattress pads where the wood beams
of southern pine could comfort my spine, it didn't.
To dream was to prevail.
They tell me to ask if I can invent a new universe,
to ask if God would let me, little old me,
award a blessing here or there.
Even grant miracles where the needs
of the spoken word exists.
In uncertain times, in forsaken times,
in tears that spoke in lieu of forbidden lines,
or a history too battered and bruised to travel.
To dream was to prevail.
Their blood flows through my hands.
Fingerprints that orchestra great powers,
they tell me, sun kissing my skin
and deepening my voice to a baritone of a million cries,
to an unanswered plight.
Beware of me.

passage.line: Their blood flows through my hands.
passage.why_fulcrum: The title line. The gifts (stars, universes, blessings) become his own body: the ancestors are now in his restored hands, so the walk to the Light Gate in 06 is inheritance, not escape.

answer.title: Show 'Em the Road (Part II)
answer.said: Boy and the road, both were in his blood.
answer.why: Same idea in an old voice: what a man is made of was carried in his blood. 'The road' also points at the walk to the gate that follows.

passage.gesture: a hand that opens and stays open
passage.gesture_detail: Both hands rise to waist height, palms up, fingers loosening open; held open and still through the line and the archive's answer, as if holding what was handed him.
passage.surface: wall: the inner stone face of a cosmic arch over the parade route

plate.why: The Ascent is 'the ancestors, the gifts' with organic cosmic arches over a parade; the arch gives a broad wall face beside him and the parade matches 05.4.

passage.staging: Locked wide-medium. POET under the arch, parade passing deep in frame. Head lowers to his open palms; the arch face beside him wakes into archive film on the answer.
